full_details: You ate at Mistress Ansell's before church. The loaf was a penny, a finger and a half short of the notch. Alse had four peeled willow wands. Gib was on the shut chronicle, and you left him. You said the glass was not bought. After morning prayer you were home, and you struck the order for a glass off the king's page. He comes down. He is not yet in a room where a glass can be brought. At three you were at St Helen's. The boys beat the wall with willow wands, and Master Thwaite had the book. Alse showed Gillis the post in Bishopsgate Street, the corner by Crosby Place, and the stone in the garden wall. It took forty minutes. There was bread and ale after. A neighbour said that with wheat where it is the Mayor might better look to the meal-tubs than the laundry-tubs. A precept against blue starch was coming from Crosby Place, and it was not paper yet. At night you wrote the three names and left the glass struck.
one_sentence: You ate a short loaf, struck a glass off the king's page, and walked three parish marks before bread and ale.
title: Four willow wands, and three parish marks
